A '''leather boots''' is the [[Leather armor|leather]] [[Armor#Boots|boots]], crafted from [[Tattered Leather|tattered leather]]. It gives 1 armor and has 200 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/leather_boots.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

The vanilla recipe is blocked and replaced by the pack's own, which sets the stats shown in the infobox.

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===

Worn, it gives 1 armor. The vanilla item gives 1 armor with 65 durability.

It adds 1 block of safe fall distance.

=== Intrinsics ===

* [[Feather Falling]] II

The intrinsics are stored on the item and applied when it enters an inventory. See [[Leather armor]] for how the tier's intrinsics work together.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Sturdy Leather|sturdy leather]]. The pack keeps the repair cost at zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely (see [[Repairing]]).

== History ==
{{History|

{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Leather armor now actually gives armor points, and uses its own safe fall distance icon.}}
